_comment: Provenance of the tian_tt_test input dataset. Hashes are SHA-256 of the file content with CRLF normalized to LF (git core.autocrlf may rewrite line endings on Windows checkouts). Checked by tests/test_tian_dataset.py.
constructed_by: T. Tian (manual reconstruction, agent-assisted SMILES -> 3D build with RDKit, glucose/structures/scripts/build_guess.py)
construction_method: Open-chain D-glucose (O2 deprotonated) from SMILES, RDKit ETKDG + MMFF conformer 199 of 300, O2-C2-C1-O1 dihedral set to 0, Sn and ligands (3 x OSiH3, H2O) placed geometrically; reactant relaxed with MACE-POLAR-1 polar-1-s (FIRE 0.2 -> BFGS 0.02 eV/A); product built from that relaxed reactant by moving only H13 from C2 to C1, then relaxed the same way.
literature_basis: Interpretation of the cluster drawing in Mushrif, Varghese, Krishnamurthy, PCCP 17, 4961 (2015), Fig. 1b/c, as reproduced in M. A. Y. Ali, MSc thesis, U. Alberta (2025), Fig. 4.1. The paper gives no coordinates; these are NOT the paper's or the CPMD run's coordinates.
model: vacuum cluster, 42 atoms, C6H22O10Si3Sn: open-chain glucose bound to Sn(OSiH3)3(H2O)(O2)(O1); no solvent, no PBC, no frozen atoms
charge_spin_basis: Model choice by T. Tian (glucose/structures/README.md: 'inferred model choices'), consistent with formal Sn(IV) + four anionic O ligands (O2 alkoxide, 3 x OSiH3) and an even electron count (230). Not stated in any literature source read so far.
relaxation_state: relaxed with MACE-POLAR-1 polar-1-s only. Every method in the standardized protocol re-relaxes these endpoints with its own potential before any path calculation.
known_header_issue: The XYZ comment lines of both relaxed files were inherited from the unrelaxed guess and read 'REACTANT, hand-built guess (unrelaxed)' -- including product.xyz. The coordinates and energies are the relaxed ones; the header text is wrong. Files are kept byte-identical to the source and NOT edited.

source.upstream_note: Tian's glucose/structures/provenance.json records these as byte-for-byte copies of untracked local output in sweep/sn_beta_hydride/build/ on his machine (source commit 34f653d).

reactant.xyz.role: reactant (H* on C2), MACE-POLAR-1-S local minimum

product.xyz.role: product (H* on C1), MACE-POLAR-1-S local minimum

atom_map_tian.json.role: Tian's zero-based atom map; config_tian_tt_test.json must agree with it

tian_polar_results._comment: Tian's saved MACE-POLAR outputs (not copied; read in place by summarize_tian_polar.py)
